paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores for two tokenization methods, MATTER and without material information, as the number of tokens during training varies. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.4 with tick marks spaced approximately 0.1 units apart. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%),” is also linear, extending from approximately 47 to 58 with tick marks spaced by 1%. The first line, represented by a solid, coral-colored line with circular markers, initially displays a value of approximately 49.5 at x=0.6 and decreases to a value of approximately 49.3 at x=1.2.  A second line, represented by a dashed, light pink line with triangular markers, begins at approximately 52.8 at x=0.6 and rises to a value of approximately 56.6 at x=1.2, with fluctuations ranging from approximately 51.2 to 57.6 across the x-axis.
